score_scale: 0-100, mean of five 0-4 supplementary rubric dimensions times 25

multiple_comparisons: Joint primary family is defined in convergence.json; quality-only report also retains Holm across 66 model x task x contrast tests.
rank_analysis: descriptive within-generation-task rank sensitivity across the full formal 11-model set; not a calibrated cross-task latent-ability ranking
interpretation: Full-model prompt-conditioning sensitivity; observed convergence is not data contamination, ability change, or a proven cause of quality differences.
